text:
Burger with cheese, lettuce, tomato, pickle and olives, plus 3 fried chicken wings.

Burger: bun ~60 g (170 kcal), patty ~100 g (230 kcal), cheese ~15 g (60 kcal), vegetables ~40 g (10 kcal), sauce ~10 g (50 kcal). Total ~225 g, ~520 kcal.

Wings: 3 wings at ~35 g each with bone, roughly 30 g edible each, so ~100 g, ~280 kcal.

Overall: ~325 g and ~800 kcal.
